collisionPolicy: only ground/support, tight building footprint proxies, NPC body/soft-blocking, and circular boundary block the player
implementation: runtime building avoidance bounds are derived per building-like renderer from projected mesh vertices where possible; bounds are shrunk on X/Z, capped at 80m by 80m, normalized to 5m player-relevant height, and split around active target interaction clearance zones
oldInflatedBoundsHandling: oversized cluster/root bounds are skipped instead of kept active beside new tight proxies
